source.english_context: Unit 08 Transportation and Getting Around Goal: use buses, trains, rideshares, bikes, walking routes, and car-related English. Daily Life English Which bus goes downtown? Does this train stop at Central Station? I need to renew my driver's license. Can you drop me off here? Where can I buy a transit pass? Which platform should I go to? Is this the right direction for the airport? How often does this bus run? What time is the last train? Do I need to pay again when I transfer? Is this seat available? Where is the nearest bus stop? How long does the trip take? Is there an elevator to the platform? Could you tell me when to get off? Vocabulary fare money paid for a bus or train ride route the path a bus, train, or car follows stop a place where a bus or train waits transfer change from one bus or train to another driver's license a card that allows a person to drive insurance paid protection for accidents or problems transit pass a ticket or card used for public transportation platform the area where passengers wait beside a train schedule a list of planned times for services or events one-way ticket a ticket for a trip in one direction round-trip ticket a ticket for a trip to a place and back delay a situation in which something happens later than planned US Customs Driving rules and license rules are different by state. Seat belts are expected. Car insurance is required in many situations. For buses, check the route, direction, and last service time. Dialogue Student: Excuse me, does this bus go to City College? Driver: Yes, but you need to transfer at Main Street. Student: How much is the fare? Driver: It is $2.50. Student: Thank you. Could you tell me when we get to Main Street?

japanese_explanation.heading: 移動前に方向と時間を確認
points: バスや電車では、路線番号だけでなく方向も確認します。同じ番号でも逆方向に行くことがあります。
車を運転する場合、免許、保険、登録のルールは州ごとに違います。住む州のDMV情報を確認しましょう。
夜の移動、乗り換え、最終バスの時間を前もって調べると安全です。
japanese_explanation.practice: Does this bus go to City College?

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 出门前确认方向和时间
points: 坐公交或火车时，不只看线路号码，也要看方向。同一条线路可能去相反方向。
如果开车，驾照、保险和车辆登记规则按州不同。要查看所在州DMV的信息。
晚上出门、换乘和末班车时间最好提前查好，会更安全。
existing_simplified_chinese.practice: Does this bus go to City College?

ko.heading: 이동 전에 방향과 시간을 확인하세요
points: 버스나 기차를 탈 때는 노선 번호뿐만 아니라 방향도 확인해야 합니다. 같은 번호라도 반대 방향으로 갈 수 있습니다.
차를 운전하는 경우, 면허, 보험, 등록 규칙은 주마다 다릅니다. 거주하는 주의 DMV 정보를 확인하세요.
밤에 이동하거나 환승할 때, 그리고 막차 시간을 미리 확인하는 것이 안전합니다.

es.heading: Confirme la dirección y el horario antes de viajar
points: En autobús o tren, confirme no solo el número de ruta, sino también la dirección. El mismo número puede ir en dirección opuesta.
Si va a conducir, las normas sobre licencias, seguros y registros varían según el estado. Consulte la información del DMV de su estado de residencia.
Para viajes nocturnos, transbordos y el horario del último autobús, es más seguro investigar con antelación.

pt-BR.heading: Confirme a direção e o horário antes de viajar
points: Ao pegar um ônibus ou trem, confirme não apenas o número da linha, mas também a direção. O mesmo número pode ir na direção oposta.
Se for dirigir, as regras de licença, seguro e registro variam de estado para estado. Verifique as informações do DMV do seu estado de residência.
Para viagens noturnas, baldeações e horários do último ônibus, é mais seguro pesquisar com antecedência.

fr.heading: Confirmez la direction et l'heure avant de voyager
points: En bus ou en train, confirmez non seulement le numéro de ligne, mais aussi la direction. Le même numéro peut parfois aller dans la direction opposée.
Si vous conduisez, les règles concernant le permis, l'assurance et l'immatriculation varient d'un État à l'autre. Vérifiez les informations du DMV de votre État de résidence.
Pour les déplacements nocturnes, les correspondances et les horaires du dernier bus, il est plus sûr de se renseigner à l'avance.

de.heading: Überprüfen Sie vor der Fahrt Richtung und Zeit
points: Bei Bus und Bahn überprüfen Sie nicht nur die Liniennummer, sondern auch die Fahrtrichtung. Dieselbe Nummer kann in die entgegengesetzte Richtung fahren.
Wenn Sie Auto fahren, variieren die Regeln für Führerschein, Versicherung und Zulassung von Bundesstaat zu Bundesstaat. Informieren Sie sich bei der DMV Ihres Wohnsitzstaates.
Es ist sicherer, sich vorab über nächtliche Fahrten, Umsteigeverbindungen und die Zeiten des letzten Busses zu informieren.
